name: repo-links
description: Turns repo#123 and owner/repo#123 in Claude's replies into links to the GitHub pull request or issue

defaultOwner.title: Default owner
defaultOwner.description: The GitHub user or organization for a bare repo#123 the owners list does not name. Empty links listed repos and owner/repo#123 only

owners.title: Owner per repo
owners.description: Repos outside the default owner, as name=owner or name=owner/repo pairs separated by commas, e.g. tool-lines-mod=fgilio, tool-lines=fgilio/tool-lines-mod

sessionRepo.title: Link a bare #N
sessionRepo.description: Link a bare #123 to the pull request or issue in the GitHub repository of the session's folder
